content.body: The M1903 Springfield rifle served the US Army from 1905 through World War II (and beyond that as a sniper rifle). The A3 version entered usage in 1942, which featured an aperture rear sight. It was used in all major theaters by US military forces. Although it ceased being delivered to US forces in 1944, some units kept them for a time.
content.brief: WEAPON: M1903A3 Springfield Rifle AMMO: .30-06 cal (7.62 mm) MAGAZINE: 5 rounds (stripper clip) MUZZLE VELOCITY: 783 m/s RATE OF FIRE: Single-round bolt action OTHER EQUIPMENT: Mk II Frag Grenades (4) M8 Smoke Grenades (2) Combat Knife Ammo Resupply Pack (1)
